usage: A whale is an aquatic animal, usually referring to a large marine mammal.
In everyday conversation, “whale” can also refer to something very large or huge.
As a noun, “whale” is used to describe animals in ecology, stories, and science education.
Adjectives and other parts of speech usually don’t combine directly with “whale,” since it is a specific species name.
In a sentence, “whale” is usually the subject or object.
